name: Graduation Stage (wings)
narrator_line: Stage wings. Observation position before the pit. Pit entrance is adjacent.
read_aloud: Stage wings. Observation position before the pit. Pit entrance is adjacent.

map.layout: The wings of the vast auditorium: rolled diplomas, a trophy table, camera lights in the dark, the orchestra pit at the front edge.
map.hazards: Camera drones watching. The orchestra pit edge (a usable hazard). Ushers on watch if the party is spotted.

voice_lines.intro: Stage wings. Observation position before the pit. Pit entrance is adjacent.
voice_lines.twist: A drone swings your way, its little red light blinking like a nervous bird. The audience would love for you to break it.
voice_lines.win: You've seen enough. The stage is a plan, now, and not a surprise.

item_hooks: Snow Ghost capsule: once per session, add a d4 to one Performance or Persuasion check made to the audience. Check only.
